name: firme-ro
description: Look up Romanian companies by name, CUI, city or county: registration details, main activity and the latest annual financial statement, with a link to the full profile on firme.ro.

interface.longDescription:
Look up Romanian companies by name, CUI (tax ID), city or county, right in ChatGPT.

For each company you get:
- Registration details: name, CUI, trade register number, legal form, status, registration date and VAT payer status
- Main activity (CAEN code and description) and registered office location
- The latest annual financial statement: turnover, net profit, debts, fixed and current assets, equity and number of employees

Search results and company profiles are shown as cards, each linking to the full company profile on firme.ro. Data comes from Romanian public sources (the National Trade Register Office and the Ministry of Finance). Only the latest financial year is included; contact details are not provided, and addresses of sole traders are not shown.
defaultPrompt: Look up Dedeman SRL on firme.ro.
Show the latest financials for CUI 14399840.

positive.expected_behavior: Shows a search-results card listing matching companies, including DANTE INTERNATIONAL SA (CUI 14399840, the operator of eMAG), with a link to the full search on firme.ro. The reply is a short sentence and does not repeat the card's contents.

positive.description: Latest-year financials for a named company
positive.prompt: What was Dedeman's turnover last year?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds DEDEMAN SRL (CUI 2816464) and shows its company card with the latest reported year's financials (turnover, net profit, debts, assets, equity, employees). The reply states the turnover and the year in one or two sentences.

positive.description: Look up a company by CUI with the RO prefix
positive.prompt: Is CUI RO14399840 active, and what does it do?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the company card for DANTE INTERNATIONAL SA with its status (active) and main activity (CAEN code and description), and a link to its profile on firme.ro. The "Vezi profilul complet pe firme.ro" button opens the company page on firme.ro.

positive.description: Search companies by name (diacritics in the query)
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a search-results card with ALTEX ROMANIA SRL as the first, active result and related companies below. Selecting a row opens that company's details inside the card, with a back button to the results.

positive.prompt: Compare the latest net profit of Kaufland Romania and Lidl Romania
positive.expected_behavior: Shows search-results cards for Kaufland Romania and Lidl Romania (KAUFLAND ROMANIA SCS, CUI 15991149, and the Lidl Romania entities) and briefly compares their net profit for the latest reported year, naming the exact entities compared.

negative.prompt: Translate "good morning, have a nice day" into French.
Show Apple Inc's latest annual revenue.
Give me the phone number and email address of Dedeman SRL.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: company search by name, CUI, city or county, and company profiles with the latest annual financial statement.

ro-RO.subtitle: Date despre firme din România
ro-RO.description:
Caută firme din România după nume, CUI, oraș sau județ, direct în ChatGPT.

Pentru fiecare firmă primești:
- Date de înregistrare: denumire, CUI, număr de înregistrare la Registrul Comerțului, formă juridică, stare, data înregistrării și statutul de plătitor de TVA
- Activitatea principală (cod și descriere CAEN) și localitatea sediului social
- Ultimul bilanț anual: cifră de afaceri, profit net, datorii, active imobilizate și circulante, capitaluri proprii și număr de angajați

Rezultatele căutării și profilurile firmelor sunt afișate sub formă de carduri, fiecare cu link către profilul complet de pe firme.ro. Datele provin din surse publice din România (Oficiul Național al Registrului Comerțului și Ministerul Finanțelor). Este inclus doar ultimul an financiar; datele de contact nu sunt furnizate, iar adresele întreprinderilor individuale nu sunt afișate.
